result.description:
Domino's Woodford is a busy, community-minded store in the heart of Woodford, QLD, serving freshly made pizzas, sides, pasta and desserts that arrive fast, taste great and hit the mark every time. As part of Australia's most recognised pizza brand, the store has built a loyal local following through convenient ordering, dependable quality and warm, friendly service. Behind the counter, the culture is energetic and customer focused, with team members encouraged to take ownership, develop their skills and enjoy coming to work. With the store continuing to grow, we are now seeking an experienced and motivated Retail Manager to lead our team, strengthen service standards and keep day-to-day operations running seamlessly.

Key Responsibilities
•	Recruit, induct, train and mentor team members, including shift runners, in-store crew and delivery drivers, and oversee rostering, shift supervision and individual performance across all trading hours.
•	Serve customers in store, over the phone and through online ordering channels, guiding them through the menu, recommending products, meal deals and options to suit their needs, and resolving enquiries and complaints promptly and professionally.
•	Oversee food preparation and order flow during peak periods so that product quality, order accuracy and delivery and pick-up times consistently meet Domino's standards.
•	Shape the store's product range and menu focus around national campaigns and local customer demand, set appropriate stock holding levels for ingredients, beverages and packaging, and define the service standards the team delivers on every shift.
•	Prepare and manage the store budget, setting sales targets, keeping labour and food costs within plan and identifying opportunities to improve profitability.
•	Maintain a safe and compliant workplace by upholding workplace health and safety obligations and food safety and hygiene standards across the kitchen, front counter and delivery operations.
•	Develop and implement the store's purchasing and promotional policies, manage supplier ordering, and set and adjust pricing on menu items, deals and offers within franchise guidelines.
•	Promote the store and its menu to grow order volumes and brand presence in the Woodford area, executing national marketing campaigns and building local initiatives such as school and sporting club partnerships, community sponsorships and social media engagement.
•	Maintain accurate records of stock movements, daily takings, banking and other financial transactions, completing wastage logs, reconciliations and end-of-day reporting through the store's point-of-sale systems.
•	Manage opening and closing procedures, cash handling and store security, and keep equipment well maintained with any faults addressed promptly.
•	Monitor sales results, service times and customer feedback, using store reports to identify and implement operational improvements.
•	Work closely with the franchise owner and the wider Domino's network on new product launches, technology updates and store initiatives.

Skills and Experience
•	A qualification at AQF Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma level; a business, management, retail or hospitality discipline will be highly regarded.
•	At least one year of experience in a supervisory or management role, ideally within retail, hospitality or quick service restaurants.

Personal Attributes
•	A natural people leader who motivates by example and stays calm and decisive under pressure.
•	Energetic and hands-on, with a real enthusiasm for fast-paced service environments.
•	A customer-first mindset and pride in getting every order right, every time.
•	A clear and confident communicator who builds rapport with team members and customers alike.
•	Well organised, with strong attention to detail and sound commercial judgement.
•	Reliable, accountable and adaptable, with a proactive approach to solving problems.

What We Offer
•	A full-time position of 38 hours per week.
•	A salary of $75,000 to $85,000 per annum plus superannuation.

How to Apply
If you are ready to take the lead at a thriving local store, we would love to hear from you. Please apply with your current resume and a short cover letter outlining your management experience and why you would be a great fit for Domino's Woodford. Applications will be reviewed as they are received, and only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented ICT Systems Test Engineer to join our team and play a critical role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of our technology systems. The successful candidate will be responsible for designing and executing comprehensive test strategies, identifying defects, and working collaboratively with development and infrastructure teams to deliver robust, high-quality solutions. This role suits a methodical and analytical professional with a strong technical background in software and systems testing, a commitment to quality assurance best practices, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment.
## Key Responsibilities
- Specify, develop, and execute detailed test plans, test scripts, and test cases to validate the behaviour, functionality, and integrity of ICT systems across multiple platforms and environments.
- Identify, diagnose, and document functionality errors and faults in systems and programming code within established testing protocols, quality standards, and compliance guidelines to ensure systems perform to specification.
- Design and conduct regression, integration, performance, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure new and updated systems meet defined requirements and business needs.
- Utilise automated test software and frameworks to streamline testing processes, improve test coverage, and increase efficiency across the software development lifecycle.
- Produce clear and comprehensive defect reports, test summary reports, and related quality assurance documentation, ensuring traceability from requirements through to test outcomes.
- Perform systems architecture reviews and assessments, evaluating current and future hardware and software configurations, and contributing recommendations to inform strategic technical direction.
- Collaborate closely with software developers, business analysts, and project managers to clarify requirements, resolve defects, and support timely delivery of system releases.
- Create, review, and maintain technical documentation including procedural guides, operational manuals, instructional materials, technical specifications, and maintenance inventory records.
- Analyse test results and defect trends to identify recurring issues, recommend process improvements, and support continuous quality improvement initiatives across the organisation.
- Participate in agile ceremonies such as sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives, contributing a quality assurance perspective throughout the development cycle.
- Assess risks associated with system changes and releases, providing input into risk mitigation strategies and supporting informed decision-making across project and operational teams.
- Support the evaluation, selection, and implementation of testing tools, methodologies, and frameworks to ensure the organisation's testing capabilities remain current and effective.
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
- Demonstrated experience in ICT systems testing, quality assurance, or a closely related technical role, with a solid understanding of the software development and systems engineering lifecycle.
- Proficiency in writing and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts across functional, non-functional, and regression testing scenarios.
- Hands-on experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, JUnit, TestNG, or comparable technologies.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose complex system faults and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Experience producing high-quality technical documentation, including test reports, defect logs, operational guides, and system specifications.
- Familiarity with agile and DevOps methodologies and the ability to integrate quality assurance activities into iterative development workflows.
- Solid understanding of systems architecture, network infrastructure, and software integration concepts relevant to enterprise ICT environments.
- Competency with defect tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, Zephyr, or similar platforms.
- Excellent communication, collaboration, and organisational skills, with a strong commitment to delivering quality outcomes within agreed timeframes.
## Preferred Qualifications
- ISTQB certification (Foundation Level or above) or an equivalent recognised qualification in software testing or quality assurance.
- Experience working in regulated industries or environments with strict compliance, security, or governance requirements, such as government, finance, or healthcare.
- Exposure to performance and load testing tools such as Apache JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
- Familiarity with cybersecurity testing principles, including vulnerability assessments and secure coding practices.
- Experience with cloud-based environments and platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud, and an understanding of how they impact testing strategies.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and associated tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Bamboo.
- A postgraduate qualification or additional certifications in project management, IT governance, or related fields, such as ITIL or PRINCE2, would be highly regarded.
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative, inclusive, and forward-thinking team that values technical excellence and continuous improvement, where your contributions directly shape the quality of systems used across the organisation.
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for industry certifications, training programmes, and attendance at relevant conferences and events.
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with options for hybrid work arrangements, supporting a healthy work-life balance without compromising on career growth.
- Work on complex, large-scale ICT projects that offer genuine variety and the opportunity to deepen your expertise across diverse technologies and industries.
- Receive a competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression within a growing organisation that invests in its people.
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our client is an acclaimed artisan bakery built on craftsmanship, community, and conscious hospitality. With a loyal following and reputation for exceptional product and genuine connection, they are seeking a hands-on Retail Manager to lead one of their high-profile market venues.
This is a leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, sensory environment—where a market stall carries the same warmth and intention as a fine dining room. You’ll have genuine autonomy to shape the customer experience, develop your team, and drive profitability. If you lead with empathy and pride in operational excellence, this is for you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Financial Control
· Manage venue operations including rostering, purchasing, and cost of goods, ensuring budget and sustainability targets are met.
· Flex labour hours dynamically in response to real-time business and weather conditions.
· Oversee stock control, invoice accuracy, and wastage reduction through proactive management.
· Conduct quality checks and resolve defects before product reaches customers.
· Identify operational improvements and collaborate with production and quality assurance teams.

Team Leadership & Development
· Lead, coach, and inspire a team of up to 20+, fostering warmth, accountability, and shared purpose.
· Manage the full performance cycle—onboarding, feedback, training, and career progression.
· Handle performance matters confidently and compassionately, in line with Fair Work standards.
· Participate in recruitment, ensuring new hires align with the brand’s values and service ethos.
· Champion change and ensure the team is equipped and motivated to adapt.

Customer Experience & Brand Leadership
· Embody genuine, unhurried hospitality; ensure every guest interaction reflects warmth and appreciation.
· Resolve customer complaints with discretion and follow-through.
· Brief the team daily on service standards, product knowledge, and experience expectations.
· Act as the ‘voice’ of the brand within the venue, ensuring consistency in tone, behaviour, and presentation.

Safety, Hygiene & Food Quality
· Maintain a zero-harm environment by enforcing safe work practices and conducting hazard reviews.
· Ensure full compliance with HACCP, GMP, and personal hygiene standards across all food handling and dispatch.
· Conduct routine product protection checks and support the broader Quality Agenda.

Administration & Compliance
· Maintain accurate filing and communication systems for senior leadership, HR, and product teams.
· Track colleagues leave balances to ensure coverage without compromising service or budget.
· Follow up on non-compliance issues promptly and escalate where required.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
· Proven min 1 year experience in retail, hospitality, or venue management.
· Strong financial acumen—rostering, COGS, and budget control.
· Demonstrated ability to lead and develop diverse teams in high-volume environments.
· Excellent communication skills; comfortable giving feedback, managing conflict, and facilitating change.
· Flexibility to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays across multiple market locations.
· Physically capable standing for long periods, lifting up to 15kg, working in varying weather conditions.

WHY JOIN?
· Respected, independent Australian brand known for quality and heart.
· Genuine career development and mentorship opportunities.
· Work with exceptional product in a setting that values tradition and innovation.
· Competitive salary + benefits.

TO APPLY
Submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your leadership philosophy and interest in the artisan food space.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. This role is advertised exclusively on behalf of our client

About Us
Discount Building Material Pty Ltd, located in Parramatta NSW 2150, is an Australian technology-driven building materials platform connecting leading manufacturers with a nationwide network of resellers. Through a single digital portal, the company streamlines wholesale ordering, delivers accurate product information, and enables seamless supplier integration to improve procurement efficiency across the building materials industry.

implemented solutions satisfy functional and operational expectations.

Located in the heart of Maitland, NSW 2320. The Whistler has become a vibrant destination known for its modern Australian menu, curated cocktails, and relaxed yet sophisticated atmosphere for Breakfast, lunch, and Dinner. The venue blends casual dining with elevated flair, offering everything from hearty brunches and share plates to evening gatherings that capture the essence of contemporary hospitality.

The Whistler is currently seeking skilled Cooks and Chefs to join its culinary team on a full-time basis. With competitive salaries ranging from AUD 75k to 85k per annum, depending on experience, this opportunity offers professionals the chance to contribute to a venue that values creativity, teamwork, and consistent quality.

Scope of the Work:
- Overseeing daily kitchen operations, including staff delegation, stock rotation, and maintaining accurate records.
- Preparing and cooking a variety of dishes, either regularly or for special functions and events.
- Managing production schedules and staff requirements to ensure timely service delivery.
- Estimating food supply needs, calculating costs for ingredients, and managing orders accordingly.
- Inspecting supplies, equipment, and work areas to ensure adherence to established quality standards.
- Analysing recipes and advising prices to menu items based on food, labour, and overhead costs.
- Working closely with team members to execute established recipes and menus with consistency and precision, ensuring alignment with seasonal availability and anticipated customer volume.
- Demonstrating new cooking techniques and introducing equipment to staff for continual culinary improvement.
- Oversee workstation readiness by ensuring mise en place is complete, equipment is functional, and kitchen operations are primed for service efficiency and food quality standards.
- Prepare and cook dishes in strict compliance with food safety and health regulations, ensuring the highest quality and hygiene standards are maintained.
-Assist in onboarding, training, and supervising new team members, providing guidance and fostering a collaborative, efficient work environment.
- Monitoring and enforcing sanitation practices to ensure compliance with health and safety regulations, including Occupational Health and Safety (WHS) and HACCP.

To be considered for this role, you should:
- Be willing to relocate if you are interstate or in other cities.
- Preferably have Certificates III & IV in Commercial Cookery
- Be available on both days at weekends and be able to work split shifts.
- Have at least 2- 3 years of work experience as a Cook/Chef.
- Ability to work in a team.
- Exceptional communication skills.

What you’ll get in return:
- Opportunities for Career Progression
- Be Part of a Historic, Community-Focused Venue
- Great work environment

How to join the team:
Please submit an online application to join our diverse, compassionate and dedicated team for a rewarding career. Only successful applicants will be contacted.

Candidates must hold Australian or NZ Citizenship or the capacity to work in Australia permanently. A temporary visa holder may only be employed if no suitable permanent resident or citizen of Australia has been identified for this position following suitable labour market testing.

Job Advertisement: Carpenter
Company Name: ARISE INFRA PTY LTD
 Location: Acacia Ridge, QLD 4110
 Job Type: Full-time
 Salary: $79,000 – $89,000 per annum

About the Company
ARISE INFRA PTY LTD is a Queensland-based residential building company specialising in the design and construction of high-quality custom family homes. The company is committed to delivering aesthetically appealing, functional, and customisable homes that meet the unique needs of its clients while maintaining exceptional standards of craftsmanship, quality, and customer service. With a strong focus on innovative home designs and reliable construction solutions, ARISE INFRA PTY LTD has established a reputation for excellence across Queensland.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Carpenter to join our team in Acacia Ridge, Queensland. The successful candidate will undertake a wide range of carpentry duties associated with residential construction projects, including measuring, cutting, assembling, installing and repairing timber structures and fixtures in accordance with construction standards, building codes and project specifications.

Key Responsibilities
•	Interpret construction drawings, plans and specifications to determine materials, measurements and installation requirements.
•	Select and prepare timber and other building materials and organise layouts for carpentry work.
•	Measure, cut and shape timber and related materials using hand and power tools to meet project specifications.
•	Assemble and install structural frameworks, sub-flooring systems and floorboards while ensuring accuracy and stability.
•	Fit and secure building components including door frames, window frames, skirting and other structural fixtures.
•	Construct and join timber components to form structures and fittings ready for installation.
•	Repair, replace or renovate damaged wooden structures, fittings and flooring components as required.
•	Inspect completed carpentry work to ensure compliance with building standards, safety requirements and project specifications.

Essential Skills and Experience
•	AQF Certificate III or AQF Certificate IV in Carpentry, or an equivalent qualification.
•	Minimum of 3 years of relevant work experience as a Carpenter.
•	Strong understanding of construction techniques, timber materials and flooring installation methods.
•	Ability to read and interpret building plans and technical drawings.
•	Proficiency in using carpentry tools, machinery and measuring equipment.

Why Join Our Team
•	Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
•	Stable full-time employment with opportunities for long-term career growth.
•	Supportive and professional working environment.
•	Access to modern tools, equipment and quality materials.
•	Opportunity to work on high-quality residential construction projects with an established Queensland home builder.

How to Apply
If you meet the above qualifications and are looking to build your career with a growing residential construction company, please submit your resume together with a cover letter outlining your skills, qualifications and relevant experience. We welcome applications from motivated and experienced Carpenters who are committed to delivering quality workmanship.

Location: Alexandria, NSW, 2015
Full-Time: Immediate start
Job Title: Retail Manager
Salary range: $79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date: 30 days

ABOUT THE ROLE
Our client is an acclaimed artisan bakery built on craftsmanship, community, and conscious hospitality. With a loyal following and reputation for exceptional product and genuine connection, they are seeking a hands-on Retail Manager to lead one of their high-profile market venues.
This is a leadership role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, sensory environment—where a market stall carries the same warmth and intention as a fine dining room. You’ll have genuine autonomy to shape the customer experience, develop your team, and drive profitability. If you lead with empathy and pride in operational excellence, this is for you.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Financial Control
· Manage venue operations including rostering, purchasing, and cost of goods, ensuring budget and sustainability targets are met.
· Flex labour hours dynamically in response to real-time business and weather conditions.
· Oversee stock control, invoice accuracy, and wastage reduction through proactive management.
· Conduct quality checks and resolve defects before product reaches customers.
· Identify operational improvements and collaborate with production and quality assurance teams.

Team Leadership & Development
· Lead, coach, and inspire a team of up to 20+, fostering warmth, accountability, and shared purpose.
· Manage the full performance cycle—onboarding, feedback, training, and career progression.
· Handle performance matters confidently and compassionately, in line with Fair Work standards.
· Participate in recruitment, ensuring new hires align with the brand’s values and service ethos.
· Champion change and ensure the team is equipped and motivated to adapt.

Customer Experience & Brand Leadership
· Embody genuine, unhurried hospitality; ensure every guest interaction reflects warmth and appreciation.
· Resolve customer complaints with discretion and follow-through.
· Brief the team daily on service standards, product knowledge, and experience expectations.
· Act as the ‘voice’ of the brand within the venue, ensuring consistency in tone, behaviour, and presentation.

Safety, Hygiene & Food Quality
· Maintain a zero-harm environment by enforcing safe work practices and conducting hazard reviews.
· Ensure full compliance with HACCP, GMP, and personal hygiene standards across all food handling and dispatch.
· Conduct routine product protection checks and support the broader Quality Agenda.

Administration & Compliance
· Maintain accurate filing and communication systems for senior leadership, HR, and product teams.
· Track colleagues leave balances to ensure coverage without compromising service or budget.
· Follow up on non-compliance issues promptly and escalate where required.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
· Proven min 1 year experience in retail, hospitality, or venue management.
· Strong financial acumen—rostering, COGS, and budget control.
· Demonstrated ability to lead and develop diverse teams in high-volume environments.
· Excellent communication skills; comfortable giving feedback, managing conflict, and facilitating change.
· Flexibility to work early mornings, weekends, and public holidays across multiple market locations.
· Physically capable standing for long periods, lifting up to 15kg, working in varying weather conditions.

WHY JOIN?
· Respected, independent Australian brand known for quality and heart.
· Genuine career development and mentorship opportunities.
· Work with exceptional product in a setting that values tradition and innovation.
· Competitive salary + benefits.

TO APPLY
Submit your CV and a brief cover letter outlining your leadership philosophy and interest in the artisan food space.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. This role is advertised exclusively on behalf of our client

About Us

Advanced Group Australia is a leading provider of skilled labour solutions across construction, civil, and industrial sectors. With a strong presence in New South Wales and an ongoing commitment to safety, quality, and workforce development, we work with top-tier clients on major infrastructure and building projects. Our team takes pride in delivering reliable, qualified personnel who keep projects moving and completed to the highest standards.

We are currently seeking an experienced and reliable Sheet Metal Worker to join our growing team.

Role

As a Sheet Metal Worker, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing, and repairing sheet metal products and structures. This includes working with materials such as stainless steel, aluminium, and galvanised iron for applications in construction, HVAC, and industrial installations. You will collaborate with supervisors, tradespeople, and site managers to deliver precise and safe workmanship that aligns with project specifications.

Key Responsibilities & Duties
- Read and interpret technical drawings, blueprints, and specifications for fabrication and installation.
- Measure, cut, bend, and shape sheet metal using hand tools, machines, and cutting equipment.
- Assemble and join sheet metal components using welding, riveting, and fastening techniques.
- Install sheet metal products, such as ductwork, roofing, flashing, panels, and frameworks on construction sites.
- Perform modifications or repairs on existing installations, ensuring all work meets quality and safety standards.
- Operate and maintain workshop machinery and tools with care and attention to safety protocols.
- Conduct inspections and quality checks on finished products or installations.
- Comply with all site safety requirements and Advanced Group’s work health and safety (WHS) procedures.

Skills & Qualifications
- AQF Certificate III in Engineering – Fabrication Trade (Sheet Metal Working) or similar (ANZSCO Skill Level 3).
- Minimum 3 years’ experience in sheet metal fabrication, installation, or maintenance.
- Proficiency in working with a range of sheet metal tools and machinery.
- Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings and specifications.
- Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills.
- Good communication skills and ability to work as part of a team.
- White Card (Construction Induction).
- Valid driver’s licence and reliable transport.

Australian citizens and permanent residents encouraged to apply.

Salary & Location
Salary: $78,000 – $80,000 per annum plus superannuation (commensurate with experience).
Location: Advanced Group Australia, Guildford NSW 2161.
